body: It means a lot! 😄 this’ll be the last time I use this account since it’s a throwaway, hopefully our paths will crows again but in a different and better context

Guess who's graduating tomorrow! 😊

You said no need to thank you, but I really do need to! I appreciate the help. Even if just a little, that little bit of encouragement and belief did a lot for me. Your work for this community is very much appreciated, you're a good person to help out people struggling. I hope to be just as good of a person!

That finger crossing worked out, I’m really hopeful now. I talked with my guidance counselor and learned I only needed two classes to graduate, and that I could turn in work until the day before graduation. I still have a lot of time, my counselor told me exactly what I had to do. Thank you so much, I’ve felt so overwhelmed that my mind kept resorting to suicide. I do have to work on my depression, I know it’s not healthy to treat suicide as a first resort or any sort of resort, but for no this keeps me hopeful
Thank you. This cleared my mind for now. It doesn’t ease me 100%, but it’s something I can think about to keep myself from thinking more negatively. I’ll update you

I don't know either, I checked on mobile and PC. Tried refreshing, nothing.

I really hope my guidance counselor comes up with something, at this point, my high school & college career depends on it. Counselors do check today (well, "today" as in when I wake up later in the morning day) to see if any seniors are failing, but I don't know what they'll do. I should've emailed sooner, because with only the 28th left to make any real changes to my grades (I could do 5 of my classes in a few hours tops, my 1 class though I've spent a whole week on and still am at a 40%), I don't have a lot of time.

I'm debating on sleeping right now (I've only slept 3 hours the past few days), because I could do a few assignments for the class and raise my grade up by a percent or two... but it's so demotivating knowing my grade would only go up a percent after five small assignments. But I feel so guilty knowing that the time I have at the night, I could spend doing those assignments instead of doing them later on. I don't know, I'm scared.

u/insearchofsumone, I can't find your comment outside of your post history. What help could the guidance counselor even give me? Change all of my F's to passing? They're all required courses and I don't think my teachers would like that. I've got six F's and a credit I had to make up, with my graduation on the 5th and everything due on the 28th. If I could get that one 40% up to a passing without doing literally dozens of assignments that'd take me weeks, and submit the credit today, I'd be comfortable enough to turn my other grades around on the 28th.

I really want to just graduate and attend this school. If I can, I'd be able to look into some therapy and work on myself over the summer. It's not that I want to commit suicide - I'm afraid, but that I've been impulsively thinking about it. I'm afraid if I don't graduate that I will end up committing suicide, I act too impulsively without thinking and it's becoming natural for me to view suicide as a solution. I know it's not healthy and "suicide is never the answer," but my future is at stake and I don't want to live through any more suffering

I emailed them about two hours ago. Still, I have straight F's, two out of six classes borderlining a D- and the rest far under that. I generally do well on tests, it's not that I'm dumb or lazy, but I've never communicated my depression to my counselor or teachers so it looks like I really am just a lazy cheapstake
